root.name: MDUリソーシズ・グループ

companies.name: オッター・テイル・パワー

relations.text: JETx送電事業を共同で保有する計画の相手である
relations.text_en: Otter Tail Power Company is the planned co-owner of the JETx transmission project

source.label: MDU Resources Group 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.label_en: MDU Resources Group 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: As part of MISO's long range transmission plan, in August 2022, the Company announced its intent to develop, construct and co-own JETx with Otter Tail Power Company in central North Dakota.

companies.name: ブラックヒルズ・パワー

relations.text: 電力供給契約を結んでいる供給元である
relations.text_en: Black Hills Power supplies power to Montana-Dakota under a power supply contract

source.label: MDU Resources Group 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.label_en: MDU Resources Group 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: Montana-Dakota has a power supply contract with Black Hills Power, Inc.

companies.name: ワイオダック・リソーシズ

relations.text: Wygen III向けの石炭供給契約を結んでいる供給元である
relations.text_en: Wyodak Resources supplies coal for Wygen III under a coal supply agreement

source.label: MDU Resources Group 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.label_en: MDU Resources Group 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: Montana-Dakota has a coal supply agreement with Wyodak Resources Development Corp., to supply the coal requirements of Wygen III at contracted pricing through June 1, 2060.

companies.name: ナバホ・トランジショナル・エナジー

relations.text: ビッグストーン発電所の燃料向けに石炭供給契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Navajo Transitional Energy supplies coal for Big Stone Station under a coal supply agreement

source.label: MDU Resources Group 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.label_en: MDU Resources Group 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: The owners of Big Stone Station, including Montana-Dakota, have a coal supply agreement with Navajo Transitional Energy Company, LLC to meet all of the Big Stone Station's fuel requirements through 2026.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
